messages:
maya: heads-up: want a quick sync on a small follow-up to the allocator/evictor refactor — proposing a deferred-free "intent" handoff to improve observability and reduce eviction churn.
raj: sounds good, show the sketch.
maya: current pain: allocator defers frees asynchronously; evictor telemetry shows eviction spikes but we cannot correlate them to deferred frees. hotset churn is noisy.
alex: seen this in prod — eviction surges after large free batches and root-cause hunting is painful.
maya: proposal (high-level):
- allocator emits a tiny `deferred_free_intent` event when it defers freeing (e.g. threshold >10ms)
- evictor subscribes to intent stream and tags eviction spans with intent_id
- pipeline emits a per-intent summary: intent_id, worker, deferred_bytes, evicted_bytes, timeline
- tiny APIs: `evictor.handoff(intent_id, hint)` and `allocator.finish_free(intent_id)` for reconciliation
raj: two immediate concerns: cost of the stream and ordering guarantees.
maya: cost: events are compact protos, batched per worker; default OFF and opt-in via feature flag. ordering: best-effort causal ordering — we only need monotonic observation windows, not strict sync.
sam: race condition: evictor could evict a slab that allocator will later mark freed — double-accounting risk.
maya: mitigation: cheap local check `allocator.peek_state(ptr)` -> {reserved|deferred|freeing|freed}. If state==deferred treat as candidate but prefer eviction only under high pressure.
alex: keep on-path operations local: per-worker ephemeral map of deferred intents; fall back to slow RPC for cross-worker pointers. avoid hot RPCs.
infra-bot: deploy ci/evict-intent-probe -> staging :white_check_mark:
raj: ops ask: how will this show up in Console? need a join by intent_id showing intent -> evict -> finish timeline.
maya: pipeline will materialize a compact JSON summary for UI; internals remain proto/binary. Console tile can query summaries by time range or intent_id.
sam: safety nets — if we detect oscillation between defer and evict, what do we do? auto-backoff or temporary pinning?
maya: proposed auto-safety: if oscillation metric >3x baseline within 1m, double defer window up to cap and enable a cooldown period. add an alert when this triggers.
jess: runbook addition: `runtask collect_intent i-<id>` that gathers logs, heap sample, and the intent summary — useful for customer debugging.
maya: perf notes: synthetic microbench shows p99 alloc path overhead +0.5-0.8ms worst-case on a single thread when intent bookkeeping is enabled; under realistic load batching reduces impact to <0.2ms. evict path unchanged.
alex: sounds acceptable behind a feature flag. wins: clearer RCA, tunable thresholds, and safety nets to reduce churn.
raj: next step: RFC addendum with API sketches, tracing spans, and Console mock.
maya: I'll draft the addendum and drop a link + staging CI job in ~2h.
raj: tagging SRE for visibility: @jess @toby
jess: acknowledged — will add dashboard tile and runbook snippet.
maya: thanks all. closing thread for now — will post RFC link later :wave:
